sections.text: You're listening to the Skeptics' Guide to the Universe, your escape to reality.
sections.title: Introduction

sections.text: The Bad Astronomer joins us to discuss some astronomy news items.
sections.title: Interview with Phil Plait

sections.text:
Item # 1: Scientists determine that the best way to maximize the probability of becoming pregnant is to have sex every day.
Item # 2: New research shows that greater than 90% of embryos used for IVF have chromosomal abnormalities.
Item # 3: Epidemiological data reveal a dramatic decrease in maternal mortality rate in Europe over the last decade.
